title: Add br CLI commands to Ringmaster worker template
description: Modify worker spawner template to include br pull-bead, br update, and br close commands in the worker loop

title: Add beads polling to worker script
description: Modify scripts/worker-claude-code.sh to poll 'br ready --json' instead of ringmaster-cli pull-bead. Add logic to convert bead JSON to task format. Test with local beads queue.

title: Add file watcher for beads changes
description: Implement file watcher or polling mechanism to detect changes to .beads/issues.jsonl. When new beads detected, wake up worker loop immediately instead of waiting 60s.

title: Integrate br (beads) with Ringmaster worker system
description: Add br integration to allow workers to pull beads from br queue instead of only from Ringmaster's internal queue. This enables hybrid workflow where interactive Claude creates br beads and Ringmaster workers consume them.

title: Document br usage for workspace
description: Create comprehensive documentation showing how to use br for task management in the workspace

title: Generate completion report to local file
description: When no beads available, generate /var/log/ringmaster/NEEDS_ATTENTION.md with stats from 'br stats', recent completions, and next steps. Include timestamp and worker pool status.

title: Test Ringmaster beads integration end-to-end
description: Spawn worker with beads support, create test beads, verify execution, check completion report generation. Validate worker correctly marks beads in_progress and closed.
